Expenses

This Month

Pending Approval

Approved
{isLoading ? "..." : data?.metrics?.approved ?? 0}

"use client"; import { Briefcase } from "lucide-react"; import { useSchoolQuery } from "@/lib/data/school-hooks"; type DepartmentOverviewData = { metrics: Record; items: any[]; }; export function DepartmentOverviewWorkspace() { const { data, isLoading } = useSchoolQuery("/admin-command/hod/department-overview"); const items = data?.items || []; return (

Department Overview

Overview of department performance and activities.

Teachers
{isLoading ? "..." : data?.metrics?.teachers ?? 0}
Subjects
{isLoading ? "..." : data?.metrics?.subjects ?? 0}
Dept Mean Score
{isLoading ? "..." : data?.metrics?.mean_score ?? 0}
{isLoading ? ( ) : items.length === 0 ? ( ) : ( items.map((row: any, i: number) => ( )) )}
Subject Teacher Coverage % Mean Score Status
Loading...
No records found. Create the first entry to get started.
{row.subject} {row.teacher} {row.coverage} {row.mean_score} {row.status}
); }

"use client"; import { Download, BookOpen, GraduationCap, Clock } from "lucide-react"; import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"; import { useSchoolQuery } from "@/lib/data/school-hooks"; export function AcademicsWorkspace() { // Fetch real data from the backend const { data: assignments, isLoading: assignLoading } = useSchoolQuery('/api/academics/my-assignments'); const { data: reportCards, isLoading: reportsLoading } = useSchoolQuery('/api/exams/report-cards'); const { data: marks, isLoading: marksLoading } = useSchoolQuery('/api/exams/marks'); const activeAssignments = Array.isArray(assignments) ? assignments.slice(0, 3) : []; const publishedReports = Array.isArray(reportCards) ? reportCards.slice(0, 3) : []; return (

Academics Overview

Track grades, assignments, and download term reports.

Recent Grades

{marksLoading ? (
) : Array.isArray(marks) && marks.length > 0 ? ( marks.slice(0, 4).map((mark: any, idx: number) => (

{mark.subject || 'Subject'}

{mark.exam || 'Assessment'}

{mark.score}%

Grade {mark.grade || '-'}

)) ) : (
No recent grades published.
)}

Active Homework

{assignLoading ? (
) : activeAssignments.length > 0 ? ( activeAssignments.map((task: any, idx: number) => (

{task.title}

{task.subject || 'General'}

Due {new Date(task.due_date).toLocaleDateString()}

)) ) : (
No pending homework.
)}

Term Report Cards

{reportsLoading ? (
Loading report cards...
) : publishedReports.length > 0 ? ( publishedReports.map((report: any, idx: number) => (

{report.term || 'Term'}

{report.academic_year || 'Year'}

)) ) : (
No official report cards have been published yet for this academic year.
)}
); } // Temporary icon definition for the missing FileText import from previous template function FileText(props: any) { return ( ) }

import { TeacherView } from "./types";

Effects are intended to synchronize state between React and external systems such as manually updating the DOM, state management libraries, or other platform APIs. In general, the body of an effect should do one or both of the following:
* Update external systems with the latest state from React.
* Subscribe for updates from some external system, calling setState in a callback function when external state changes.
